_comment: Router activation fixtures. Every prompt here is copy-pasted verbatim from a real transcript in ~/.claude/projects. Do not write fresh examples: a hand-written prompt tests the pattern against itself and always passes, which is how the previous activation fixtures stayed green while nothing fired. If no real prompt exists for a lane, the lane has no evidence it is needed.
